violations.text: Tomatoes, jalapenos and cheeses were observed held at 42-44 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were assessed and placed into other refrigeration to chill. Unit was adjusted during time of inspection. Ambient of unit was observed between 49-53 degrees Fahrenheit post adjustment. Establishment to properly adjust unit, if unable to service may be required. No foods that require refrigeration for food safety may be placed in this unit until unit can maintain an internal food temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or less. Establishment has adequate refrigeration for normal operations. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/19/2026
The following were observed in poor repair: -digital display of walk-in cooler temperature read out -soap dispenser at handsink (held together with tape) New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2026

Active leaks in basement from discharge pipes occur when 3 bay and food prep sinks are in use. PIC informed. Plumbing systems to be maintained in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 12/03/2026

Floors that are being wet from leaking plumbing discharge pipes in the basement were observed in poor repair (coating observed chipping and peeling away from subfloor). PIC informed. The physical facilities to be maintained in good repair and proper adjustment. Finish Approved Schedule provided during time of inspection. https://datahealth.ri.gov/publications/requirements/FoodProtectionAppovedFinishSchedule.pdf New Violation. Correct By: 01/19/2027
Establishment does not have an individual with the Rhode Island Manager Certified In Food Safety license. PIC states application was placed in the mail. New Violation. Correct By: 08/22/2025
The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2025
Establishment does not have an individual with the Rhode Island Manager Certified In Food Safety license. Application provided during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/22/2025

Various foods in the walk-in cooler were observed held at 44-54 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Time/temperature abused foods were voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2025
The walk-in cooler was observed at 50-51 degrees Fahrenheit. Unit was taken out of service to hold foods that require refrigeration for food safety. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2025
2 door lowboy was observed at 55 degrees Fahrenheit. Unit was taken out of service during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2025

The dumpster outside is located on gravel. The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2023
